name: Surakshit Matritva Aashwasan Yojana
benefit:
> **Under SUMAN, beneficiaries are entitled to the following free and cashless services at designated public health facilities:**

**Maternal Health Services**

- Minimum 4 Antenatal Care (ANC) check-ups, including one in the first trimester
- At least one check-up under Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)
- Free and cashless normal delivery and Caesarean section (C-section)
- Manage
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a pregnant woman. 1. The applicant must be a mother (post-delivery) seeking services at a public health facility. 1. Newborns aged 0 to 6 months old will be able to avail the benefits of this scheme. 1. After delivery, lactating mothers up to 6 months from delivery are also eligible for this scheme.
